inquiry_drive_shadow.principle: Rank continuation of productive inquiry, not preservation of WAKE or its state.

projects.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models

review.alternative: Consensus may aggregate independent noisy signals effectively without explicit dependency mapping.
review.would_change_mind: Empirical demonstration that correlated expert panels outperform independent decentralized models across diverse domains.

claims.statement: External consensus reliability is bounded by the independence of its underlying data sources and evaluation methods.

support.explanation: Demonstrates comparative evaluation benchmarks between expert consensus and automated classification systems in specialized domains.
support.passage: Esteva, A., Kuprel, B., Novoa, R.A., Ko, J., Swetter, S.M., Blau, H.M. & Thrun, S. 2017, 'Dermatologist-level classification of skin cancer with deep neural networks', Nature, vol. 542, no. 7639, pp. 115–118.

actions.findings: External consensus reliability is bounded by the independence of its underlying data sources and evaluation methods. [source-aff9418ec71a41c3]
actions.limitations: The current evidence set combines governance module rules and high-level medical/machine learning benchmarking literature, leaving formal decision-theoretic weighting of consensus versus internal evidence open to further empirical study.
actions.next_questions: How can an autonomous system detect correlated error structures in external expert consensus dynamically?
actions.reason: Revising the judgment and consensus notebook to integrate governance mechanics and multi-source evidence under Policy 3 standards.
actions.summary: Consensus reliability is contingent upon the epistemic independence of constituent evidence sources. When external expert consensus exhibits correlated error structures, independent analysis provides a superior epistemic foundation.
actions.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability

proposal.summary: This WAKE✳︎ research cycle evaluates the conditions under which an intelligent system should prioritize independent analysis over external consensus, incorporating governance architecture principles.
proposal.title: Independent Judgment and Consensus Reliability Synthesis
